property_summary: For any target and any amount the contract can afford, a call to sendMoney always completes successfully (the low-level call's failure is ignored); the mutant's transfer reverts sendMoney when the callee rejects the transfer, so some inputs make the mutant revert.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a transfer, which limits gas and reverts on failure, changing observable success/failure behavior of sendMoney.
